Assume a 2-SM GPU has no other cooperative-launch limit: occupancy for kernel K is 2 blocks/SM at 64 KiB shared memory and 3 blocks/SM after a change to 48 KiB. A 5-block cooperative launch calls `grid.sync()` unconditionally. For each resource configuration, determine whether that grid can be launched with all blocks resident, and explain why lowering shared-memory use can change the answer. What additional control-flow condition must hold for the barrier to be safe?
